doc.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Advice to young musicians and close of the interview
summary: Carter urges young players to find their own voice; Berger ends the interview.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: Okay. Is there anything you’d like to add or any message to people that may be using this interview in years to come or any small piece of advice y you would impart?

Well, all I would say is, to the budding musician or the instrumentalist, is try to find your own voice with respect to everybody that has gone before you or everybody who is here now. But try to find your own voice and say your own thing.
Okay. Well, you’ve certainly said yours very well. Thank you.
